name: mimu-geonode-myanmar-ward-boundaries-mimu
notes:
Ward shape file (polygons) for Myanmar which includes 236 towns.
Source: Digitization based General Administration Department (GAD) Township profile maps 2018, except for Sagaing, Kengtung, Taungoo and Hpa-An cities based on field sources.

P-codes missing in Kyaikto (Mon): 1 ward
